claims.head: The Canadiens should drive the play

MTL.head: Advantage, the Canadiens
MTL.body: Even though Montréal will be without Suzuki, the Canadiens have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. On top of that, Winnipeg will be without Morrissey. The Jets can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.

story.head: The Jets are desperate for a win
paras: The Jets are winless in eight (0-6-2), while Montréal has won four straight. The Canadiens won the teams’ first meeting this season, 2-1 in Winnipeg on Oct 25. Going in, the Jets are seventh in the Central (tied for 26th in the NHL) and the Habs second in the Atlantic (tied for sixth).

The Jets have played better than their record (.393) says: their chances are worth about .451, and their finishing has held them back. The Canadiens’ record (.692) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.567), largely thanks to pulling off wins in one-goal games.

The Jets create more chances on the penalty kill than almost anyone (2nd) and rarely ice the puck (5th). They also take a lot of low-quality shots (30th), so the Canadiens wait for good looks, but them settle for hopeful ones. Winnipeg has scored 2.43 goals a game, the third fewest in the league. On the other side, the Canadiens get into more chippy games than almost anyone (3rd), take more penalties than they draw (32nd) and give up a lot of dangerous shots (29th). The Canadiens are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Jets.

Kyle Connor (11 G / 4 A / 15 P in 14 GP) leads the Jets in scoring, with five goals in six games against Montréal since 2023-24. Mark Scheifele (2 G / 10 A / 12 P in 14 GP) isn’t far behind. For the Canadiens, Cole Caufield (8 G / 4 A / 12 P in 13 GP) leads the way in scoring, and Lane Hutson (3 G / 8 A / 11 P in 13 GP) is next in line.
Stuart Skinner (3-3-3 / .899 SV% in 9 GS) is in line to start for Winnipeg. Jacob Fowler (6-1-0 / .942 SV% in 7 GS) has been a rock in net for Montréal and will likely start.
The Canadiens usually control more of the chances than the Jets do.
